title: Saved email sections are shared across the team and devices

source.ref: owner 2026-10-20: saved sections live in a database table (EMAIL-040 decision card); PROG-EMAIL1

detail: Built 2026-10-20. Migration 20270346015100 creates email_saved_sections (service-role only, 60-row cap in the action); the Email Studio editor reads and writes it through writer-gated actions. Until the migration is applied in production the library shows empty and a save is refused, so apply it once its PR is the next migration PR to merge.

verify.note: PASS 2026-10-20: saved sections live in the shared email_saved_sections table through writer-gated actions and show for every operator on every device; the browser-storage list stays as the fallback for editors with no shared library. Production needs the migration applied.
